description: Lets the injected session-recovery script report what it observed about the sign-in state. Unlike capabilities/remote.json this grant takes caller-supplied input, so per that file's own rule it lives in its own capability with a narrow host list rather than the wildcard: only YouTube origins, which is where the script runs. The sign-out it diagnoses reproduces about once a day, so the launch that exhibits it has to be self-diagnosing.
